name: Easy Newsletter – Gutenberg block editor newsletter
author: FARN Labs

sections.description:
Create newsletters using familiar WordPress blocks, content and theme styles. Subscriber data is stored in your WordPress database. Email delivery uses your website’s mail configuration.

Features

  • Create and send newsletters in the WordPress block editor
  • Signup forms with double opt-in, welcome email and spam protection
  • Manage subscribers and subscriber categories in WordPress
  • Use theme styles and customize newsletter design
  • Convert newsletter content into email-compatible HTML
  • Use posts, custom post types and custom fields
  • No plugin limit on subscriber or newsletter counts; sending capacity depends on your hosting and mail provider
  • Send test emails and monitor or stop newsletter delivery
  • Add attachments from the media library and personalize content
  • Use your WordPress mail configuration, including SMTP plugins
  • Display a newsletter archive with a block or shortcode
  • Review subscriber details, consent records and sending history

Additional Pro features

  • Filter recipients by subscriber categories or custom fields
  • Use WordPress users as newsletter recipients
  • Schedule newsletters for later delivery
  • Import subscribers from CSV files
  • Comprehensive newsletter statistics with open and click reports
  • Manage three additional custom fields in the subscriber list

sections.installation:
• Install and activate the plugin in WordPress.
  • Open Easy Newsletter and configure the sender, signup form and email delivery settings.
  • Create a newsletter and send a test email before sending it to subscribers.
sections.faq:
Where is subscriber data stored?

Subscriber data is stored in your WordPress database. Mail delivery and any configured external services depend on your website settings.

Can I use an SMTP plugin?

Yes. Configure email delivery in WordPress and test it with a newsletter test email.

Are all WordPress layouts displayed identically in email?

Email clients support different design features. Always check a test email in the email clients relevant to your audience.
